about: Jobs found by Claude's weekly browser sweep

items.title: Assistant Dockmaster - Deep Point Marina
items.snippet: Full-time dock crew at the Bald Head Island ferry marina (85 slips, may cover the 170-slip BHI marina). Asks for public-facing + marina experience, which matches his 8 seasons. Needs an NC driver licence.

items.title: Rigger — Tracker Boat Center
items.snippet: Full-time, rigging motors and accessories on new boats at the Myrtle Beach Tracker boat center. Hands-on boat work at home with no licence needed. Pay not posted (ZipRecruiter estimates $21.50–28/hr).

items.title: Marine Construction Crew Member
items.snippet: Marine construction crew (docks, piers, bulkheads from barges) between Georgetown and Charleston, $18–35/hr. Work on the water with real pay; his boat handling helps.

items.title: Deckhand
items.snippet: Deckhand on a Miami private/event charter yacht (day boat, not live-aboard). Passenger-vessel sea time counts toward a USCG captain licence. Pay not listed. Posted in the last 7 days.

items.title: Sales Development Representative
items.snippet: Remote entry-level SDR selling construction-site software (Hilti company). A field/trades product suits his hands-on background. Posted in the last 7 days.

items.title: Sales Development Representative, High Growth B2B SaaS (Remote)
items.snippet: Remote SDR, $55–60k base, B2B SaaS. Entry-level; his Best Buy/Meta demo work is the pitch. Posted in the last 7 days.

items.title: Sales Development Representative -- Remote Position
items.snippet: Remote SDR, $55–70k, selling a government-affairs data product. Entry level, one of the best base salaries this week. Posted in the last 7 days.

items.title: Data Annotation Specialist - Computer Vision
items.snippet: Remote $20–35/hr labelling construction/landscape plans for an AI model. No degree needed; good practice for AI-trainer work. Posted in the last 7 days.

items.title: Video Data Annotation Specialist
items.snippet: Remote video annotation for AI training data, entry-level gig work. Pay not listed. Posted in the last 7 days.

items.title: Seasonal Brand Ambassador
items.snippet: Holiday-season brand ambassador at the NMB outlets. Direct match for his brand-ambassador résumé; quick to land. Posted in the last 7 days.

items.title: Detailer
items.snippet: Vehicle detailer in Myrtle Beach with a $1,000 sign-on bonus. Steady hours; detailing skills carry over to boats. Posted in the last 7 days.
